# A calmer way to work through what comes next.

Timeline Shift™ AI helps people understand what may be driving a difficult decision, explore it at their preferred pace, use a structured decision tool, identify one manageable next step, or find relevant UK support.

This is an early private beta, and honest feedback will help improve what feels useful, confusing, emotionally accurate or in need of improvement.

- Timeline Shift™ AI is not therapy, diagnosis, medical advice or a crisis service.

- You control how much you share and can stop at any time.

- Do not enter names, addresses, passwords, financial details, medical-record numbers or identifiable information about other people.
